# Ralph-Loop Template

> Language-agnostic project template using Ralph Loop autonomous development with plugin-based scaffold architecture.

## Getting Started

- [README](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, scaffold workflow, quickstart
- [Contributing](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, quality commands, commit format
- [Template usage](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/docs/TEMPLATE_USAGE.md): DevContainer sizes, Makefile details, submodule consumption, Vibe Kanban setup

## Ralph Loop

- [Ralph README](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/ralph/README.md): Autonomous agent development loop
- [Ralph contributing](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/ralph/CONTRIBUTING.md): Ralph-specific command reference

## Governance

- [Agent rules](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md): AI-agent behavioral rules and quality thresholds
- [Agent learnings](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/AGENT_LEARNINGS.md): Compound learnings across sessions
- [Agent requests](https://github.com/qte77/ralph-loop-cc-tdd-wt-vibe-kanban-template/blob/main/AGENT_REQUESTS.md): Open escalations from agents
